paragraphs.text: Dark's Keep was a fortress on the island of Madara . Dark's Keep was located near Madara 's western coast. This structure was home to the Imperial Assassin Ramses Overdark , for which it was named. Surrounded by swampland and a branch of the Suido River , it provided Lord Dark with bountiful access to the black and blue mana he implemented.
During the Madara-Edemi War , the keep was destroyed by the Bogardan Seismic Mage Kolo Meha under the instruction of Tetsuo Umezawa .
